description.value: Narita Sushi is a Japanese restaurant in Coquitlam serving sushi, aburi, sashimi, and Japanese comfort foods with both dine-in and takeout options. Described by customers as a hidden gem, it is known for its modern take on classic Japanese dishes using fresh, high-quality ingredients. The booth-style seating and friendly staff make it a welcoming stop for cyclists passing through Coquitlam.
